newsitem.title: UK: Cortecs wins Japan blood test approval.
newsitem.headline: Cortecs wins Japan blood test approval.

text.p: Anglo-Australian biotechnology group Cortecs International Ltd said on Tuesday its HelisalTM rapid blood test had been approved by Japan's Koseisho regulatory authority.

The approval follows the go-ahead from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration last year. Cortecs said it believed the Japanese approval was the the first for a product from the British biotechnology sector.
HelisalTM Rapid Blood is a doctor's office test to detect antibodies against the H.pylori bacterium which is the major cause of duodenal and gastric ulcers.
Cortecs said H.pylori was the second most common infection known in man after tooth decay with an estimated figure of over 200 million people being infected worldwide.
